Sandbox_ZedHUD_TimerLayout_tooltip: Under compass: one line centered under the compass. PUBG style: time and distance-to-next-zone bar above the minimap, plus a center notice when the phase changes.
Sandbox_ZedHUD_MapConeRequireCompass: Map direction cone needs a compass
Sandbox_ZedHUD_MapConeRequireCompass_too: On: the direction cone on the map and minimap is only drawn while you carry a compass. Off: it is always drawn. Your position dot is not affected either way.
